not_yet.speaker: kaj7
not_yet.text: You are early. The gate is still closed and the signal is still east. I will wait; waiting is a thing I am good at.

greet.speaker: kaj7
greet.text: Hello. I am Kaj-7. I was a shepherd unit until something woke me and called me by a name I did not have. It is still calling. It is somewhere down there. May I walk with you?

choices.text: A machine that wants things. What could go wrong.
[Vault] We had a unit like you in the vault. It sang to the door until the door opened.

signal.speaker: kaj7
signal.text: I do not know. It sounds like many voices agreeing. When I follow it I feel less like a shepherd and more like a sheep. I would like to find out which I am, with someone watching.

choices.text: Walk with us. We'll find your signal.
Sera, you've fought machines. Your call.
We don't carry things that hear voices.

sera_call.speaker: sera
sera_call.text: It asked. The drones under the grates never asked. Bring it.

choices.text: Then it's settled. Walk with us.

refused.speaker: kaj7
refused.text: You came back. That is data. Is the answer different now?

recruited.speaker: kaj7
recruited.text: The signal is louder when the Beacon is deeper. I have made a graph. It is not a comforting graph.

frightened.speaker: kaj7
frightened.text: I do not have the part that does that. I have the part that keeps checking whether the door is locked. It is checking now.
